name: Thoracic Extension on Foam Roller

instructions.description: Lie on your back with a foam roller placed horizontally under your upper back and knees bent.
Support your head with your hands and gently lift your hips enough to position the roller at a comfortable segment.
Extend your upper back over the roller a small amount while keeping the lower ribs controlled.
Return to neutral, then reposition the roller slightly if you want to mobilize another area.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use short holds or slow repetitions over the upper back only.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use the top of a chair back for a similar supported extension.

commentsNotes: Avoid rolling into the lower back.
The movement should stay gentle and localized to the upper back.
